# Properties reference

Every method of the properties resources and every object they return. Types link to their section; objects used by several areas are in [shared objects](shared.md).

## Methods

<a name="properties-methods"></a>
### `Properties`

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `withLocator(Locator $locator)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the home or area of the locator. |
| `find(list<PropertyFieldGroup\|string> $fields = [], bool $includeRd = false)` | [`Property`](#property) | Property characteristics |
| `energyLabel()` | [`EnergyLabel`](#energylabel) | Energy label |
| `woz(bool $indexed = false)` | [`Woz`](#woz) | WOZ value and history |
| `condition()` | [`Condition`](#condition) | Condition score |
| `transactions()` | [`Transactions`](#transactions) | Transactions |
| `hasTransactions()` | `bool` | Transactions available? |
| `valuation(?DateTimeInterface $asOfDate = null)` | [`Valuation`](#valuation) | Home valuation |
| `valuationPlus(?DateTimeInterface $asOfDate = null)` | [`ValuationPlus`](#valuationplus) | Home valuation plus |
| `valuationHistory(?DateTimeInterface $from = null, ?DateTimeInterface $to = null, bool $includeRd = false)` | [`ValuationHistory`](#valuationhistory) | Valuation history |
| `references(?int $limit = null, ?int $maxDistanceInMeters = null, ?int $maxAgeMonths = null, ?bool $sameType = null, ?int $minLivingAreaInSquareMeters = null, ?int $maxLivingAreaInSquareMeters = null, ?int $minConstructionYear = null, ?int $maxConstructionYear = null, ?DateTimeInterface $asOfDate = null, ReferenceSort\|string\|null $sort = null)` | [`References`](#references) | Reference homes |
| `surroundings()` | [`Surroundings`](#surroundings) | Surroundings |
| `environment()` | [`Environment`](#environment) | Environment |
| `withMaxCacheAge(int $seconds)` | `static` | Returns a copy that keeps answers at most this many seconds in the cache. |
| `withoutCache()` | `static` | Returns a copy that neither reads nor writes the cache. |
| `withBagId(string $bagId)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the home with the BAG id. |
| `withPostcode(string $postcode, int $houseNumber, ?string $extension = null)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the home at the postcode, house number and extension. |
